title: Enable Concurrent Processing of Multiple WARC Files
description: Implement functionality to allow concurrent handling of multiple WARC files. The system should be able to parse user input to identify multiple WARC files for processing and process each file simultaneously.

title: Implement Grouping Functionality for WARC File Processing
description: Develop functionality to group WARC files for processing based on user-defined criteria. The system should allow grouping by: explicit naming (process files specified by exact names), wildcard patterns (*.warc to select files), size limitations (filter files based on size thresholds), and number of items (limit the total number of files selected for processing).

title: System crashes when processing a large number of files
description: When the user inputs 20 or more files, the system freezes and is unable to process any of the files or take any more input. System is only back to normal functionality when the console is fully restarted.

title: Use distributed processing to enhance system efficiency
description: Enable the system to handle large-scale WARC file collections by implementing distributed processing and efficient data transport mechanisms. The solution should divide the workload into smaller tasks that can be processed in parallel across multiple nodes and use a distributed task manager to coordinate and assign tasks to each node.

title: Ensure functionality on any operating system
description: Include configuration files to handle OS-specific settings, like file paths, environment variables, and library installations. Currently works on Windows but not iOS.

title: Remove unnecesary dependencies
description: Get rid of all superfluous GUI packages, remove operating-system specific tools, and reduce reliance on proprietary systems.

title: Communication with APIs does not adhere to RESTful architectural style
description: The system uses POST and GET queries rather than DELETE, for example on line 231.

title: Create log to record steps of the application running.
description: Create instance of Java Logger class and put log statements in each step of WARC parsing and processing.

title: pip install is broken on Linux and OSX

title: Extract entire WARC file?
description: I have several multi-gigabyte WARC files that I need to completely unpack. Is this possible or not? Running warcextract on the file just gives me some basic information about the WARC. Apparently it wants an offset but I want to extract the entire thing

title: G-Zip Content-Length
description: Warctools uses the Content-Length field to determine the length of the body for validating and reading WARC files. Since the g-zipped bodies are no longer g-zipped in common-crawl WARC files, not the whole of g-zipped messages is being parsed.

title: warcfilter.py needs to import logging
description: It's used in parse_http_response. Could you update asap? We are using it but it fails because it has not imported logging.

title: Streaming interface to warc files.
description: Avoid parsing entirety of warc file. Don't parse http records inside. Any improvements we can make to mean that large and gargantuan warc files can be read and processed speedily

title: Drop hanzo namespace as not to collide with original hanzo-warc-tools.
description: Suggestions for new namespace? I am happy with warctools

title: Python 3.10 / Ubuntu 22.04
description: Hello, Apologies if I just missed this answered elsewhere or if there's an easy solution I'm just not skilled enough to figure out, but it seems that since Ubuntu whatever-the-hell versions and/or python 3.something made such drastic changes to the site/dist packages, these tools have a cascading series of modules that aren't found. title: Create shell script wrappers for commonly used commands.
description: Develop shell script wrappers for warcvalid and arc2warc. These wrappers should provide default configurations, support custom options, and include logging and error handling.

title: Create command line flags to allow users to restrict collection and output.
description: For example, -C to specify content type, -l to limit the number of files outputted, etc.

title: The user has no configuration options for migrating from ARC to WARC.
description: When using arctowarc, the user does not have the options available in other commands such as specifying record selection, processing rules, and logging.

title: Grouping by name should not be case sensitive.
description: When processing multiple WARC files and grouping by name, the tools are by default case sensitive. We should allow users to specify with a command line flag like -cs whether or not the grouping should be case sensitive

title: Log timestamp issue
description: The timestamp in the logs is by default in UTC. It should be adjusted to reflect the user's timezone.

title: Error when migrating from ARC to WARC
description: Even when ARC file is in specified directory, a FileNotFoundError is thrown. This indicates that there is a bug in the arc_parse function

title: Create basic UI for building migration configurations
description: Make form where user can open a file picker to input the file to be migrated and a text box where they can put their configuration options. Don't worry about styling or submission of the form yet.

title: Connect user interface to migration build functionality
description: When the user fills the required fields on the form and clicks submit, the migration is built. Display a simple success message indicating to the user that the migration has been built.

title: Migration API returns incomplete data
description: When sending a GET request to the endpoint '/migrations/config-options', the data sent back does not include the data indicating output format and compression options. This may indicate an issue when initializing these configurations or an error in the migration API logic.

title: Implement Error Handling.
description: Currently when an error is thrown, it crashes the program. Create error catching to safely notify the user of incorrect input or configurations without completely escaping the program.

title: Handle User Inputted Metadata
description: After the file conversion, format indicated metadata and store it in the converted file.

title: Default METADATA is placeholder information
description: We need to update our placeholder metadata with the default metadata indictated by IIPC

title: Initialize and update database with migration info
description: Create tables to store migration metadata, including ARC and WARC file names, conversion timestamps, and file sizes. Implement logic to update database records during and after each migration process with data such as migration status, errors encountered, and processing durations.

title: Integrate JHOVE into migration API
description: Configure JHOVE to validate ARC and WARC file format and call its functionality during file parsing

title: Add atomic transaction checkpoints
description: Introduce "start-trans"� and "end-trans"� markers at key points in the file migration, ensuring that each transaction is fully completed before being accepted. If a migration fails mid-process, no partial changes should be allowed, and the system should automatically roll back any incomplete operations.

title: Inaccurate Dry-Run Reports
description: There are errors that are not accounted for by the simulated run. Issues related to file system permissions, file integrity, and disk space are not fully captured in the dry-run process.

title: Decompose Database Into Multiple Tables.
description: Currently we are storing all new and old records of any form in our central database. I want to split this database into multiple tables: one for new records and one for old records.

title: arc_warc_verify
description: Create a function called 'arc_warc_verify' that uses checksum comparisons to compare METADATA from WARC to ARC in order to verify that the migration succeeded.

title: Insufficient Record Filtering
description: When repackaging WARC files, we currently only allow filtering records based on size. We should be allowing the user to filter by many more fields such as: URL, MIME-Types, timestamp, and any other field in the WARC specification

title: Create exportable reports for each WARC file
description: I want the user to be able to view data about their migration in a clear and concise report. This report may include a summary of the migration, any errors that occurred, and/or performance metrics. These reports should be exportable as a CSV, PDF, or XML file.

title: WARC browser does not display information in a user friendly format
description: The UI displays everything in unstyled HTML lists which is very unappealing and makes it difficult to find data for a specified file. The UI should display WARC information in a table format, with a column for file name, WARC summary report, and file location.

title: Create Tool to Compare WARC Files and Sets of WARC Files
description: Implement algorithm that identifies the difference between specified criteria in multiple WARC files. For example, let a user compare the timestamp on two WARC files.

title: Use Diff Tool on Crawls
description: In assuring consistent functionality and detecting any errors, the diff tool should contain a function that allows the developers to view the difference between crawls

title: Enhance User Experience by Rewriting WARC Browser URLs
description: Provide a rewrite engine to automatically rewrite URLs based on predefined rules. The engine will intercept incoming requests and transform them given the specified rules.

title: Proxy mode causes some WARC content to not be displayed.
description: When in proxy mode on the WARC browser, the location of WARC files is left blank. This may be due to some issue in retrieving user session data.

title: Provide functionality to search WARC file content within WARC browser
description: Make a search bar on the WARC browser. When a user types in this field, search-tools module will be called and the list of WARC files will be filtered based on inputted content.
